description: This source file defines a factory class for creating Akka actor configurations related to health checking within the 'Ditto' service framework. It provides a method to generate Props objects for health check actors, with options for persistence and other child actors.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckingActorFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing a static method to create Props for health checking actors in an Akka ActorSystem, with optional persistence and additional child actors.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates a Props object for a health checking actor with specified options, optional persistence checker Props, and other child actor Props. It constructs a LinkedHashMap of child actors based on the options provided and returns a configured CompositeCachingHealthCheckingActor.
